# 3 bed house for sale

> This spacious three-bedroom townhouse extends to approximately 115 sq.m. and is situated in the popular Athlumney Wood development. Its generous living accommodation offers a practical layout for family life. The property has parking to the front and enjoys an open outlook across a large green area. To the rear is a paved, low-maintenance garden with gated access.

## Fakta
- Typ: house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 115 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 24 The Park, Athlumney Wood, Navan
- Cena: 310 000 €
